profile.headline: Cyber Security Software Engineer | GFACT | GSEC | GCIH

positions.title: Cyber Security Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Idaho Falls, Idaho, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
▪ Developed features for CyOTE to identify potential cybersecurity threats.
▪ Leveraged the MITRE ATT&CK Framework to enhance detection capabilities within CyOTE.

positions.title: Vulnerability Verification & Validation Intern
positions.description:
▪	  Coordinated the disclosure of Operational Technology vulnerabilities.
▪       Built automation tools using Python and Bash.
▪       Contributed efforts to enhance and develop in-house tools.

positions.title: Help Desk Phone Analyst
positions.description:
▪	Provided technical support on basic software and hardware issues.
▪	Documented issues for resolutions or escalation to tier 2 support.
▪	Assisted with installation of various systems and software patches.

positions.title: Clinical Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪	Recruit research participants, verify eligibility for studies, and obtain informed consent/assent.
▪	Maintain a good working knowledge of all assigned research protocols and reporting requirements.
▪	Performed data collection, entered data into a database, cleaned and audited data using software for accuracy.

positions.title: Audio Visual Technician
positions.description:
▪	Provided troubleshooting techniques in integrating professional audio/video systems.
▪	Monitored and repaired audio, video, control systems and video conferencing equipment.
▪	Interface with customers to explain operations and instill confidence in the installed systems.
